 Eligible Airtel prepaid users can get a second recharge free on the Rs 349 and Rs 399 popular 28-day recharge plans, but only through the Airtel Thanks app
 by Sagnik Das Gupta Published: 8 November 2026, 13:51 IST Add as preferred source Share Image Credit: Beebom Gadgets
 Summary
 Airtel is offering a limited-time "1+1 Recharge Free" deal on its Rs 349 and Rs 399 prepaid plans.
 The offer effectively doubles the validity to 56 days, bringing the effective monthly cost down to around Rs 175 and Rs 200.
 It’s only available to select users through the Airtel Thanks app, so you’ll need to check whether it shows up on your account.
 Airtel has started rolling out a Buy 1 Get 1 Free offer on its Rs 349 and Rs 399 prepaid plans, giving eligible subscribers a second recharge of the same plan at no extra cost
 The "1+1 Recharge Free" is available for a limited time through the Airtel Thanks app and it appears to be showing up only for select accounts.
 Airtel Buy 1 Get 1 Free Offer: Plan Benefits
 Both the Rs 349 and Rs 399 prepaid recharge plans come with 28 days of validity, unlimited local and STD calls, and 100 SMS per day. With the free second recharge, you effectively get 56 days of service for the price of one.
 The Rs 349 plan offers 2 GB of daily data along with unlimited 5G data in areas with Airtel 5G coverage. It also bundles Airtel’s free 12-month Adobe Express Premium subscription , which the telco values at around Rs 4,000, along with free Hellotunes and Airtel Safe. 
 The latter includes real-time spam call alerts, fraud link blocking and Airtel’s AI-powered Fraud Alert against OTP scams .
 The Rs 399 plan goes a step further with truly unlimited 4G and 5G data. That means there’s no daily data cap and it works on all handsets, not just 5G phones . It also includes the Adobe Express Premium subscription.
 Benefit Airtel Rs 349 Plan Airtel Rs 399 Plan 
 Validity 28 days (56 days with offer) 28 days (56 days with offer) 
 Data 2GB/day + unlimited 5G Unlimited 4G and 5G, no daily cap 
 Calls Unlimited local and STD Unlimited local and STD 
 SMS 100/day 100/day 
 Extras Adobe Express Premium (12 months), Airtel Safe, free Hellotunes Adobe Express Premium (12 months) 
 Effective monthly cost ~Rs 175 ~Rs 200 
 To check whether you’re eligible, open the Airtel Thanks app and look for a “1+1 Recharge Free” tag on the Rs 349 or Rs 399 plan before you pay. If you don’t see the tag, the offer hasn’t been extended to your number yet.
 We checked on our end and we have received the offer via the Airtel Thanks app. 
 Airtel hasn’t officially detailed how the free recharge is applied. With Jio’s version of the offer (via MyMobileIndia ), the free month was credited as a voucher and activated automatically once the paid plan expired. 
 Airtel’s offer is likely to work similarly, but it’s worth checking the plan details in the app before recharging.
